notes: Resident individuals. Income from salary and other sources at normal rates; capital gains taxed at special rates, agricultural income and business presumptive schemes are not covered yet.

regimes.name: New regime
regimes.description: Lower rates, few deductions. Applies unless you choose the old regime when filing.

deductions.label: Employer's contribution to NPS
deductions.hint: Up to 14% of basic salary; enter the eligible amount.

regimes.name: Old regime
regimes.description: Higher rates, but most deductions and exemptions are allowed.

deductions.label: House rent allowance exemption
deductions.hint: The exempt part of your HRA, as worked out by your employer.

deductions.label: Tax-saving investments
deductions.hint: EPF, PPF, ELSS, life insurance premiums, home loan principal, children's tuition fees.

deductions.label: Health insurance for you and your family
Health insurance for your parents
deductions.hint: The higher limit applies when a parent is 60 or older.

deductions.label: Home loan interest (home you live in)
Interest on savings accounts
deductions.hint: Seniors can include interest on deposits too.

deductions.label: Eligible donations
deductions.hint: The deductible amount after the 50% or 100% rule for each charity.

deductions.label: Employer's contribution to NPS
deductions.hint: Up to 14% of basic salary; enter the eligible amount.
